content.title: Jahangir Khan's House Demolished in West Bengal
content.caption: Former Trinamool Congress strongman arrested for extortion, murder, and criminal intimidation.

slides.heading: Jahangir Khan's House Demolished in West Bengal
slides.text: Former Trinamool Congress strongman arrested for extortion, murder, and criminal intimidation.

slides.heading: Arrest and Demolition
slides.text: Jahangir Khan was arrested on July 8 for extortion, murder, and criminal intimidation. His house was demolished in Falta, West Bengal.

slides.heading: Impact
slides.text: Several notices were issued to Mr. Khan to remove the structure. The building exceeded two storeys and lacked approval.
